name: What is the process for ADU architectural planning with Hometelligent Inc.?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for ADU architectural planning with Hometelligent Inc.?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our ADU architectural planning process begins with an initial consultation to understand your vision, budget, and site constraints. We then move to conceptual design, refining layouts and aesthetics based on your feedback. Once approved, we develop detailed construction documents and coordinate with structural engineers as needed. We aim to submit a comprehensive permit application package that meets all requirements for cities like Pleasanton or San Leandro, guiding you through each step.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hometelligent Inc.'s ADU architectural planning involves consultation, conceptual design, detailed construction documents, and permit application support.
